entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. If you think it's wise,..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. If you think it's wise, we will target House Sazon only."

entries.dialogueText: "I would focus my efforts on keeping order in the realm. At this time, encouraging unity among the Houses seems more prudent than stoking discord."

entries.dialogueText: "As is your right, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""If you wanted to... you could use..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you wanted to... you could use your mother's birthday as an occasion to remind the nobles in question where Rizia's true power lies."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Ah, yes. That's good thinking.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. That's good thinking."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "If that's everything, I shall take my leave."

entries.dialogueText: "And if I believed that keeping the Royal Houses in line was integral to keeping order in the realm?"

entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I am sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I am sure."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Very well, Your Majesty. There may yet be time to solve this diplomatically."

entries.dialogueText: "That depends. What do you mean by decisive?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Ah. Yes, that makes sense."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes widened."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes widened.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I see...""
entries.dialogueText: "I see..."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Though it won't get to the core of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though it won't get to the core of the nobles' resentment against you."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It's more difficult to go against..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's more difficult to go against a royal house than a wayward merchant. But the Golden Guard can handle it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“But such an unfolding of events in..."
entries.dialogueText: “But such an unfolding of events in front of the other Houses could provoke unrest and undermine our position.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“On the contrary, Your Majesty. Suc..."
entries.dialogueText: “On the contrary, Your Majesty. Such a decisive action would serve as a stark warning to all Houses.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“It would ensure they remain in the..."
entries.dialogueText: “It would ensure they remain in their place and think twice before plotting against you.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“And just as important, it would de..."
entries.dialogueText: “And just as important, it would demonstrate that dissent against the King is met with swift and uncompromising action.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "By the sound of it, it seems you've had such a contingency plan in place for quite some time."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty, when I say the Guard..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, when I say the Guard is prepared for any contingencies, I mean *every* possibility."

entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Such a decisive action would serve..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a decisive action would serve as a stark warning to all Houses.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "If it ensures the safety of the Crown, I am prepared to take such measures."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I thought you might be.”"
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you might be.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: “How would you carry this out, exactly?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I like the way you think, Captain."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: "“At some point in the course of the..."
entries.dialogueText: “At some point in the course of the birthday gathering, you'd corral your targets into a room with only one exit. This one, for instance."

entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We could then declare our control..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could then declare our control over the House’s assets and force them to sign over their lands on the spot.”

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: “On your command, I and my men would overwhelm the other nobles with a decisive show of force.”

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can't afford the possibility of..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't afford the possibility of failure. I want this plan scrapped."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "We will prepare as thoroughly as possible, but in operations of this scale, nothing is ever 100% certain."

entries.dialogueText: "Okay, so let's say I agree to this plan. How would we carry it out?"

entries.dialogueText: "As to how it might proceed..."

entries.dialogueText: "I will not have my reign remembered for such brutality."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "I still believe there are less extreme measures to address our challenges."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: “If we execute this plan efficiently enough, it need not be brutal."

entries.dialogueText: "No... I'm not convinced. I want the birthday gathering to go as planned."

entries.dialogueText: "The situation isn't as dire as it seems. We can manage this with careful negotiation and avoid rash decisions.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Letting events unfold naturally is the wiser course of action. These situations usually resolve themselves."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "In any case, if there's nothing else you need from me, I'll take my leave."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Then I apologize if I've overstepp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I apologize if I've overstepped. I will speak of it no more."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus bowed."
entries.dialogueText: Titus bowed.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "You've made yourself clear, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "It sounds like a good plan. But I don't think you should be the one to execute it. I don't want you putting your life on the line."

entries.dialogueText: "It seems to me that the Golden Guard would be best suited at pulling off such an operation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "What if they refuse?"

entries.dialogueText: "When you frame it like that, I can't help but feel increasingly uneasy about whether this is the right approach."

entries.dialogueText: "I thrive on fear and animosity."

entries.dialogueText: "I'm aware, Titus. Let's implement this plan."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "And if they don't comply, we shoot them."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "If they dared to defy the Crown in such a way, they would be subject to punishment at your discretion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And then what?""
entries.dialogueText: "And then what?"

entries.dialogueText: "Once the signing is complete, you'd bring the nobles back into the library building with the announcement that the targeted House's lands are now under the control of the central authority, and their titles have been stripped.”
